Name: Jen's Mega Coop and Barn
Author: jenf1
Description:
[size=3][b]This mod is only available here at Nexus Mods! If you see it anywhere else, it has been uploaded without my permission and should be taken down immediately![/b][/size]

[size=5]Features:[/size]

- Adds a third upgrade option to coops and barns: Mega Coop and Mega Barn
- These upgrades are built by going into Robin's build menu
- Mega Coops and Mega Barns hold 24 animals each
- Mega Coop comes with a second, removeable incubator (version 1.1.0 and up only)
- The new upgrades draw from the same building picture as their previous Deluxe counterparts. No need for mod authors to make an additional building for compatibility!
- Mega Coops and Barns interiors are double the size of Deluxe interiors and are clean and clear of debris. (There are other mods that clean out the previous coop and barn interiors, however I will release my own if there's request for it.)

[size=5]Config Options:[/size]

Install the mod and run the game using SMAPI at least once in order to generate a config.json file.
This is for better compatibility with other mods that may also add their own Coop or Barn upgrades.

- [b]Mega Coop[/b]: Choose whether or not you want the option to upgrade to Mega Coop. (True, False) Defaults True
- [b]Mega Barn[/b]: Choose whether or not you want the option to upgrade to Mega Barn. (True, False) Defaults True

[size=5]Install:[/size]

- Download and install [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2400]SMAPI[/url] and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url].
- Copy [CP] Jen's Mega Coop and Barn into your Stardew Valley/Mods folder
- Load the game using SMAPI and enjoy!

[size=5]To Uninstall:[/size]

- Sell or relocate all the animals inside the coop or barn.
- Once the coop or barn is completely empty, you can safely demolish the building and remove the mod.
- You MUST demolish the building before removing the mod! It will not revert back and will cause errors if you don't!
